Title: Login with valid email and password
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter valid email and password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: User lands on dashboard; session created

Title: Apply Annual leave within balance
Steps:
1. Open Apply Leave
2. Select Annual and dates
3. Submit
Expected Result: Request created as Pending; balance shows 20 (15 after approval)

Title: Apply Sick and Unpaid leave
Steps:
1. Submit Sick leave request
2. Submit Unpaid leave request
Expected Result: Both created as Pending; Annual balance unchanged

Title: Manager approves direct report's request
Expected Result: Status Approved; balance deducted; employee receives approval email

Title: Manager rejects with valid comment
Expected Result: Status Rejected; comment saved; rejection email sent with comment

Title: Reject login with wrong password
Steps:
1. Enter valid email and wrong password
2. Click Login
Expected Result: Generic 'Invalid email or password' error; no session; failed-attempt counter +1

Title: Reject start date in the past
Expected Result: Validation error 'Start date cannot be in the past'; nothing saved

Title: Reject end date before start date
Expected Result: Validation error; nothing saved

Title: Reject without comment blocked
Expected Result: Validation error; status stays Pending

Title: Reject login with unregistered email
Steps:
1. Enter unregistered email and any password
2. Click Login
Expected Result: Same generic error as wrong password (no user enumeration)

Title: Reject password missing uppercase/digit/special
Expected Result: Each rejected with a policy message naming the missing rule

Title: Successful login resets failure counter
Steps:
1. Fail 4 times
2. Log in successfully
3. Log out and fail 4 more times
Expected Result: Account not locked (counter reset after success)

Title: Overlapping pending requests
Steps:
1. Submit request for +5..+7
2. Submit second request +6..+8
Expected Result: Second request blocked as overlapping (see open question)

Title: Double-click Submit creates one request
Steps:
1. Fill valid request
2. Double-click Submit quickly
Expected Result: Exactly one request created

Title: Cannot act on already processed request
Steps:
1. Open request in two tabs
2. Approve in tab 1
3. Reject in tab 2
Expected Result: Tab 2 action fails with 'already processed'; status remains Approved

Title: Email with leading/trailing spaces and mixed case
Steps:
1. Enter padded mixed-case email + valid password
2. Login
Expected Result: Email trimmed and matched case-insensitively; login succeeds

Title: Reason with emoji, unicode and HTML
Expected Result: Text stored and shown literally; no script executes

Title: Comment of 10 spaces not accepted
Expected Result: Treated as empty; validation error

Title: Account locks after 5th consecutive failure
Steps:
1. Enter wrong password 4 times
2. Verify account status
3. Enter wrong password a 5th time
4. Enter the correct password
Expected Result: After 4 failures account still active; after the 5th failure account is locked; correct password rejected with 'Account locked for 15 minutes' message

Title: Lock expires after 15 minutes
Steps:
1. Attempt login at T0+14:59
2. Attempt login at T0+15:00
Expected Result: 14:59 rejected (locked); 15:00 succeeds with correct password

Title: Request length boundary 29/30/31 days
Expected Result: 29 and 30 accepted; 31 rejected with max-length message

Title: Annual leave balance boundary
Expected Result: 10 accepted; 11 rejected 'Insufficient balance'

Title: Password length boundary 7/8/9 characters
Expected Result: 7 rejected; 8 and 9 accepted

Title: Password length boundary 19/20/21 characters
Expected Result: 19 and 20 accepted; 21 rejected

Title: Start date today and end = start accepted
Expected Result: Accepted as 1-day request

Title: Rejection comment boundary 9/10 chars
Steps:
1. Reject with 9-char comment
2. Reject with 10-char comment
Expected Result: 9 rejected; 10 accepted

Title: Reason length boundary 0/250/251
Expected Result: Empty and 250 accepted; 251 blocked (counter/validation)
